notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 21 p. 371: "a new defensive line from Richeval, five miles northeast of Blamont, south and east through Tanconville to Bertrambois and Lafrimbolle"; ch. 20 p. 362: "On 7 November the LXIV Corps had on line, from north to south, the two-regiment 553d Volksgrenadier Division". Location support: CMH names Blamont and the line. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US XV Corps (79th Infantry Division) and French 2d Armored Division.
